summary: Extensions should make compaction hierarchical, source-linked, and testable against durable project state.

items.text: Maintain layered checkpoints: a tiny active frame, per-phase summaries, and immutable raw event history, each with stable IDs and supersession links.
Seed the compact frame with repository entry points and retrieval keys rather than duplicated documentation, then fetch the smallest authoritative slice for the current step.
Run a periodic contradiction and constraint-recall report that compares the active frame with current code, decisions, tests, and unresolved work.
Before a destructive or high-impact action, rehydrate the relevant raw requirements, approval, and safety checks even when the compact summary appears sufficient.

See Topic Switching in One Long Operator Context for the related use case or counterpoint: Keep a session warm while shared context saves orientation time; reset it when repair density shows that old topics have become interference.
